sources.description: RACESEL.LBX blocks 15..27 visually match the 13 preset races in canonical race order; block 28 is the custom-race portrait
RACEICON.LBX blocks 0..168 form a 13 race x 13 variant matrix in canonical race order
OpenMOO2 colony screens use RACEICON variants 1, 3, 5 and 7 for farmer, worker, scientist and marine population icons respectively; used as factual usage evidence only
OpenMOO2 graphic.ini semantic-to-LBX mappings; selected mappings are independently revalidated against the local 1.31 archive structure and block hashes
Published MOO2 graphics-format notes identify BLDG0.LBX block 0 as the Alien Management Center on the colony screen

Orion2.exe 1.31 Cache_Load_Bldg_ (LE object 1 offset 0x9F6DC) computes (building_id-1)/10 for BLDG archive selection and remainder*36 for the building group, then calls Bldg_Coords_To_Effective_Frame_ (offset 0xAC8A6), which maps a 6x6 colony grid to frames 0..35 in serpentine row order. Function byte ranges are hash-validated before generation.
ESTRINGS.LBX block 0 offset 0xE0F contains the archive format string BLDG%D.LBX referenced by Cache_Load_Bldg_
